caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure with long dark hair, dressed in a long-sleeved, floor-length red garment. The figure is standing within a rectangular frame that has a thick black outline. The inner border of the frame is colored with alternating sections of red and teal, and the background inside the frame is yellow. Above the figure's head is a decorative element resembling draped curtains in teal, bordered with red. The figure is holding a blue oval object in its left hand at chest height, while the right hand is raised with the index finger pointing upward. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the number "25" appears at the lower left corner of the page outside the frame.
title: Plate 25: The Lost Child: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
